title: AccessToken
description: A personal or service access token.

_id.description: The unique identifier of this token.

name.description: The human-readable name of this token.

role.description: The built-in role associated with this token.

customRoleIds.description: Custom role identifiers assigned to this token.

token.description: The token value. Only returned at creation time.

serviceToken.description: Whether this is a service token.

defaultApiVersion.description: The default API version for this token.

creationDate.description: Unix epoch timestamp when the token was created.

lastUsed.description: Unix epoch timestamp when the token was last used.
